content.text: You're an independent [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-honest-side-side|Digital Product]] creator in a country where Stripe, PayPal, and other [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-step-step-deployment|payment]] processors are blocked or severely restricted. You're tired of the uncertainty and fees of working with a third-party platform. You need a sovereign digital commerce stack that's free from platform control and restrictions. In this guide, we'll show you how to deploy a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages for free, without relying on Stripe or any other payment processor.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The conventional wisdom is that building a digital store requires a platform like Shopify or Gumroad, which can be expensive and restrictive. However, with Cloudflare Pages, you can host your digital store for free and use free tools like Apps Script and NOWPayments to process payments. This infrastructure works because it's built on a foundation of free and open-source tools, which gives you complete control and flexibility. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can avoid the fees and restrictions of traditional platforms and focus on building your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to set up a GitHub account and a Cloudflare account. You'll also need to choose a domain name and set up a DNS provider. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and set up a payment method. If you want to deploy Stack 02, which includes Supabase and Cloudflare Workers, you'll need to have some experience with coding and development. However, with Stack 01, which includes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, you can deploy a digital store without any coding knowledge.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you've set up your Cloudflare Pages site, you'll need to configure your payment pipeline using NOWPayments. This involves setting up a payment method, such as a cryptocurrency wallet, and configuring the payment processor to send payments to your wallet. You'll also need to set up a delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to send digital products to your customers. With NOWPayments, you can process payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies, including popular coins like Bitcoin and Ethereum, and send payments to any wallet address in the world.
Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free requires no coding knowledge and no platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipelines, you can go live with your digital store. To do this, you'll need to create a product and upload it to your Cloudflare Pages site. You'll also need to configure your payment processor to send payments to your wallet. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment processor will automatically verify the payment on-chain and send the payment to your wallet. You can then send the digital product to the customer using your delivery pipeline.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is live and processing transactions, you can start scaling your business. To do this, you'll need to upgrade your infrastructure to handle more traffic and sales. With Stack 02, you can use Cloudflare Workers to scale your payment processor and delivery pipeline. You can also use Supabase to manage your customer database and orders. With Stack 01, you can use GitHub Pages to host multiple sites and Apps Script to process payments and send digital products.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, you'll need to follow these steps: Set up a GitHub account and a Cloudflare account, choose a domain name and set up a DNS provider, create a NOWPayments account and set up a payment method, configure your payment pipeline using NOWPayments, set up a delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, create a product and upload it to your Cloudflare Pages site, configure your payment processor to send payments to your wallet, go live with your digital store, and test your payment and delivery pipelines. You can also upgrade your infrastructure to handle more traffic and sales by using Cloudflare Workers to scale your payment processor and delivery pipeline, or by using Supabase to manage your customer database and orders.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01 on Cloudflare Pages?

Deploying Stack 01 on Cloudflare Pages takes 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This is because Stack 01 is designed to be easy to deploy and requires no coding knowledge. With Stack 01, you can deploy a digital store quickly and easily, without any technical expertise.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 and Stack 02 are two different digital commerce stacks that offer different levels of scalability and customization. Stack 01 is designed for small businesses and individuals who want to deploy a digital store quickly and easily, while Stack 02 is designed for larger businesses and enterprises who need more scalability and customization. Stack 02 includes Supabase and Cloudflare Workers, which provide more advanced features and scalability for larger businesses.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both platforms offer free hosting and a range of features that make it easy to deploy a digital store. With GitHub Pages, you can deploy a digital store in minutes, while with Cloudflare Pages, you can deploy a digital store in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint.
How do I process payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies?

You can process payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies using NOWPayments, which is a free payment processor that integrates with Cloudflare Pages. With NOWPayments, you can accept payments in any cryptocurrency, and send payments to any wallet address in the world. This makes it easy to deploy a digital store that accepts a wide range of payment options.
Can I send digital products to customers using Cloudflare R2?

Yes, you can send digital products to customers using Cloudflare R2, which is a free storage service that integrates with Cloudflare Pages. With Cloudflare R2, you can store and deliver digital products to customers quickly and easily, without any technical expertise.
